test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Neeraj Chopra ranked at which position in the World Athletics Men's Javelin rankings as of 10 August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**second.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In the most recent World Athletics Men's Javelin Rankings, Neeraj Chopra rose 14 spots to take **2ⁿd position** overall.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is only rated second to **Johannes Vetter of Germany** in the World Athletics rankings with **1315 points.**
 
• **Vetter** has **1396 points**, which puts him in** first place.**
 
• Neeraj Chopra became the** first Indian track and field athlete** to win the gold medal in the **men's javelin **event at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics.**
 
• Neeraj won the competition with a throw of** 87.58 meters.**
 
• He celebrated his comeback on **June 14, 2022**, by setting a new national record at the **Paavo Nurmi Games in Turku, Finland**, of **89.30 meters.**
 
• After only 15 days, he achieved **89.94m** on June 30, 2022, at the **Stockholm Diamond League in Sweden**, shattering his own personal best of 89.30m.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Indian track and field athlete** Subedar Neeraj Chopra** PVSM VSM is the current javelin throw Olympic champion.
 
• He is from **India's Khandra, Haryana.**
